title: Which Card Entries Count as the Charge at a Dental, Vision or Hearing Provider
content:
On a recovery against a Ridgecrest Healthy Options Card, what the card has been charged at dental, vision and hearing providers is counted from a different set of that card's entries according to what the stretch looked at contains.

**The rule.** What the card has been charged at those providers is counted from the transactions that settled alone where the card carries a transaction at such a provider the network refused in that stretch; from the transactions that settled together with those still only authorised where the card carries no refused transaction but carries one still only authorised at such a provider in that stretch; and from every transaction posted at those providers in that stretch in every other case.

**Condition and result.**

- *Condition:* the stretch looked at carries at least one transaction at a dental, vision or hearing provider that the network refused. *Result:* the charge is the total of the transactions at those providers that settled, and of nothing else.
- *Condition:* the stretch carries no refused transaction at such a provider, but carries at least one still only authorised. *Result:* the charge is the total of the transactions that settled together with those still only authorised.
- *Condition:* neither of the above. *Result:* the charge is the total of every transaction posted at those providers in the stretch.

**Worked through on hypothetical entries.** Suppose the stretch looked at carries four entries at such providers: 80.00 USD settled, 45.00 USD settled, 30.00 USD authorised and not yet settled, and 25.00 USD refused by the network. A refused transaction stands in the stretch, so the charge is counted from what settled alone: 125.00 USD. Take the same entries with the refused one removed: no refused transaction stands but an authorised one does, so the charge is the settled entries together with the authorised one, 155.00 USD. Take them again with both the refused and the authorised entries removed: the charge is every transaction posted at those providers, 125.00 USD.
